stem.en: Sponges represent one of the simplest animal body plans, and their bodies lack true tissues and organs. Which feature of sponge cells supports placing them in the animal kingdom?

feedback.en: Animal cells have mitochondria, and sponge cells do too.
Sponges do not make food. They take food particles from the water.
Right. The cell has a membrane and no wall outside it, which is the animal pattern.

text.en: Presence of a rigid cell wall

feedback.en: A cell wall is found in plants and fungi. Animal cells have none.

explanation.en: Animal cells are bounded by a cell membrane and have no cell wall. Sponge cells follow this pattern, and they get food from other organisms.

hints.en: Which options describe a plant or a fungus instead?
